criterion.R23: Extender dashboard existente: lista priorizada por causa, proximo paso y responsable; distinguir cobro real de fecha de membresia; acciones medibles
criterion.UX17: Registrar y etiquetar hechos reales; no equiparar clic/plan/PDF con contacto, entrega o retencion

inputs.new_worktree: Only from COMMON33 HEAD after root announces it

roles.managers: Canonical professional OWNER or ADMIN with current active/nondeleted/invitationNULL identity, parent and SV; full task scope only own effective gym.
roles.nutriologo: Canonical persistent membership and explicit new permissions; WHERE assignee_id=actor.id in EVERY list/detail/history/write; only completion of its assigned open task. No read:stats, aggregate gym metrics, assignee list, editing or reassignment.
roles.mfa_recommendation: No new step-up action: ordinary operational tasks alter neither team membership/RBAC nor billing. Existing full MFA login and mandatory team/billing grants remain unchanged. Any stronger new step-up policy requires an explicit root matrix, not a hardcoded bypass.

FollowupTask: client_id legacy1..36 composite FK gym/client RESTRICT
FollowupTaskEvent: result fields sufficient for operation ACK; no password/token/contact/body dump
data34.uniqueness: One OPEN task per gym/client/cause (partial unique index). Terminal task never reopens; new explicit creation when cause is again/currently present makes a new task ID.
data34.append_projection: Projection + one attributable immutable event in same transaction. Version increments exactly once; no-op edit rejected. Direct DML must not bypass immutable identity/history or terminal transitions. Final PG/SQLite invariants and function/trigger counts require the mechanism review before API acceptance; no assertion of already-proved parity.
data34.no_legacy_backfill: No tasks/actors/events inferred from AuditLog, plan dates or membership dates.
data34.rollback: Empty34 downgrade can return exact33; nonempty operational history refuses destructive downgrade and requires reviewed restore. Targets22-33 and prior assertion sources immutable.

enums.allowed_steps: membership_date_passed permits review_client_record/review_membership_date; plan causes permit review_client_record/review_plan_history.
enums.meaning: review_recorded is an actor declaration persisted by the app. It is not a provider-confirmed contact, delivery, clinical benefit, renewal, payment or retention outcome. No in_progress in v1.

source_authority.new_task: Client active/nondeleted with exact gym ownership; server recomputes current cause and evidence hash under the authorised transaction. Client-supplied cause/hash is a stale-view guard, never authority.
source_authority.cause_snapshot: Only count/last authorised plan timestamp and administrative membership date needed for the selected cause, with observed_at. Source Plan writes need not all lock Usuario; snapshot is true at the observation query, not a promise that a cause remains true at commit or forever.
source_authority.live_task: Task remains a task if its cause disappears; fresh GET reports cause_currently_present. No automatic completion. Inactive/deleted/foreign source is excluded from normal work DTO/complete; explicit archive/cancellation of hidden source would need separately reviewed authority.
source_authority.assignee: Canonical current gym owner or active/nondeleted accepted ADMIN/NUTRIOLOGO member of same gym, invitationNULL; never viewer or other gym. Empty string invitation state is not NULL.
source_authority.assignee_ineligible: Keep historical assignment; return eligible:false without contact lookup. Block completion until there is a current eligible responsible; managers may explicitly reassign. No automatic reassignment.
source_authority.reactivation_semantics: Eligibility is current, not a new membership epoch. OFF->ON or rejoining same UUID may make the persisted assignment eligible again. Do not misuse session_version as employment generation or promise permanent invalidation without an additional approved durable mechanism.

transaction.locks: Discover current task/assignee as hints; lock actor, canonical gym/parent and required old/new assignee Usuario IDs in total order NOWAIT. Re-read/revalidate required set, then Cliente and task in consistent order. Abort whole transaction with409 busy if set changed/contended; no partial retry or later Usuario acquisition.
transaction.cas: PATCH/complete/cancel require observed task ID and strict expected_version; exact version under task lock. At MAX reject409 before any event. Unique open-task constraint handles concurrent creation.
transaction.session: New owned function-scoped Session, no auto-commit finalizer. GET no DML/commit. Writer commits projection+event once; ACK and cleanup must complete before success. Reuse accepted cleanup semantics; close/rollback/ACK uncertainty =>503 opaque, no automatic readback/retry.
transaction.rls: ENABLE/FORCE two new families for effective gym. Double gym/client predicates in application and exact recipient predicates for Nutri. No SECURITY DEFINER, BYPASS, new role, global stats grant or GUC treated as actor signature. Security review must distinguish tenant RLS from route-level per-assignee RBAC.

wire.strict: Bodies extra-forbid, no body actor/gym/role/timestamps, integers reject bool/float, confirm strictly true. New task/event/request IDs canonical lowercaseUUID; legacy client/assignee IDs remain valid1..36 strings. Mutations require Idempotency-Key lowercaseUUID.
wire.lists: items,next_after,as_of,scope= gym|assigned,limit. Tasks50 default/max100; history20/max50; assignees20/max50. Stable created_at+id order, immutable tuple cursor (bounded <=256 ASCII, strict decode, no authority), live eligibility/status: no promise of snapshot across HTTP pages.
wire.bounds: JSON stream <=8192 bytes before parse; one mutation/event, typed snapshot <=4096bytes; list/history response <=131072UTF8; stats+per-cause summary <=524288UTF8; metrics <=16384UTF8. Reject whole overflow, never truncate a task/result. Read metrics max62 civil days, exact ISO (no epoch numeric), America/Mexico_City bounds into UTC; no SLA/debt threshold invented.
wire.idempotency: Unique gym+actor+request_key across new task operations. Same key+same canonical method/path/body => durable applied operation ACK after current reauthorisation, no second version/event. Different input =>409 key_reused. Old access/role/team cannot replay a former grant. Stored result contains only scalar operation fields, no display names/PII.

errors.409 followup_cause_changed: source no longer matches observed cause
errors.409 followup_busy: lock contention/set change no partial retry
errors.503 followup_unavailable: read/whole-result budget failure, no fake zero

wire.headers: Exact new API family and SSR /seguimiento+slash private no-store/no-referrer all statuses/methods/opaque500; preserve neighbours/GIS/other existing policies. Never trust downstream arbitrary CSP.

dashboard_addition.existing_readonly_stats: Keep existing cause priority1..4, plans/ledger/PDF source metrics and payment_evidence=unavailable. Never equate fecha_fin_suscripcion with debt or SaaS invoice with client payment.
dashboard_addition.additive_summary: A single bounded query for visible candidate client IDs adds per_cause_tasks[] with cause,task_id,version,next_step,responsible,current status; max4 per client. responsibility=per_cause_tasks. Legacy responsible:null is deprecated/not interpreted as no assigned task. No N+1 or unbounded second fetch; strict consumer/contract changes explicit.
dashboard_addition.new_metrics: Managers only with existing read:stats and new manage capability. state_now(open/unassigned) versus event_period(created/completed_declarations/cancelled/assignment_changes). Every counter reports as_of/range/scope/source/coverage. No click counts, retention or medical ratios; completion actor and assigned responsible distinct, no inferred work by the assignee.
dashboard_addition.source_coverage: Only current authorised nondeleted active clients; hidden sources never leak via totals. No personal diary/progress/notes/cache enters this module.

acceptance_before_integration: Freeze COMMON33-based source; reproduce missing34 endpoints with real primary+MFA login where active, both factories. Never mint positive acceptance bearer or create_all fake head.
Preserve33 and22-32 targets/fixtures/asserts; empty/populated33->34, repeat, drift, interruption full rollback, nonempty downgrade refusal.

PG actual NOSUPER/NOBYPASS/NOOWNER, two gyms, two Nutri: list/detail/history/write and totals cannot cross tenant or assignee; viewer/personal/ambiguous OWNER deny; own canonical OWNER and ADMIN work.

Concurrent create one open task, edit versus complete/cancel, same/different key, stale observed version, source/assignee change, R11 lock-order contention, reset/logout/SV and parentOFF; no deadlock or partial events.
ACK before/after commit, close before/after cleanup, rollback/invalidate failure, pool1/reuse/context restoration; exact replay has one durable event/version, no false rollback or success.
READ operations have zero DML/commit, response/body/cursor/date/enum bounds, all error headers including405/429/500 and neighbouring routes.

Separate populated restore34 preserving all complete33 criteria plus assigned/unassigned/completed/cancelled tasks, immutable history/keys, unavailable assignee, RLS/trigger signatures and restored authorised replay/cross-scope negatives.

Independent security of SQL invariants/per-assignee route authority and QA/backend/UI composition before R23 completion claim. Function/trigger counts fixed from actual DDL, no assumed no-functions claim.
root_signature_points: Approve these enums/states and ordinary-task MFA policy without changing current team/billing grants.
Approve live assignee eligibility (no invented membership epoch/permanent invalidation).
Approve two new RLS tables and explicit additive per-cause dashboard summary; approve exact API names/DTO budgets before UI consumer.
SQL/projection invariant prototype and independent security remain acceptance gates, not evidence delivered by this design.
